Company: Chikku Robotics
Tagline: Intelligent Robots for a Smarter Future
Headquarters: India
Global offices: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam | Tamil Nadu, India
Mission: To make advanced robotics and AI technology approachable, beneficial, and accessible to businesses and society worldwide.
Vision: A world where intelligent robots work alongside humans seamlessly — enhancing productivity, safety, and quality of life across every industry.

text:
Chikku Robotics core value — Human-Centered Design.
Every robot we build is designed with people in mind — intuitive, safe, and trustworthy.

Chikku Robotics core value — Innovation Excellence.
We push the boundaries of what is possible through continuous R&D and breakthrough technologies.

Chikku Robotics core value — Collaboration.
We partner with universities, governments, and industry leaders to accelerate the robotics revolution.

Chikku Robotics core value — Sustainability.
Our robots are designed for energy efficiency and long-term environmental responsibility.

Chikku Robotics core value — Trust & Safety.
Safety is non-negotiable. All our robots meet international safety standards including ISO 13482 and ISO 10218.

Inspiration: Chikku fruit (Manilkara zapota)
Pronunciation: Chik-koo
The Chikku fruit, also known as sapodilla, is beloved across Asia for its natural sweetness and nourishing qualities. Just like the fruit, our robots are designed to be naturally welcoming, trustworthy, and enriching — seamlessly integrating into human environments to make life better. The name reflects our philosophy: technology should be as approachable and delightful as biting into a sweet Chikku.
Brand colors — primary: Deep Blue (#1A237E), accent: Warm Orange (#FF6F00)
